title: The Korean War (1950–1953)
key_facts: War between North Korea (backed by the USSR/China) and South Korea (backed by the UN/USA)
Began with North Korean invasion in June 1950; major UN counteroffensive and Chinese intervention
Armistice signed in 1953 created the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ); no formal peace treaty
causes: Division of Korea after World War II at the 38th parallel
Cold War rivalry and competing regimes in North and South
Border clashes and escalation following political instability
outcome: Stalemate and armistice; Korea remains divided
Massive casualties and destruction; militarization of the peninsula
Set patterns for Cold War proxy conflicts and US alliance commitments in Asia
impacts: Institutionalized US security architecture in Asia (e.g., alliances)
Influenced Cold War strategy and nuclear considerations
